rationale: Price has been steadily fading from the recent high near $216.70, with the last five candles showing a clear sequence of lower highs and lower lows, now sitting at $215.58 and drifting away from the 9-EMA ($215.78) rather than toward the take-profit at $217.50. The position reached a maximum favorable excursion of 1.04% but has given back roughly half of that gain, and the momentum that justified the entry (volume surge, breakout above VWAP) appears to be exhausting with no news catalyst to reinvigorate it. Locking in the small remaining gain preserves capital given today's already negative realized P&L and the overhead resistance from the large gap down from $225.
